# Example prompt, student revision app

```text
Use $specforge. I want to create a mobile app that helps students plan revision sessions, track weak topics, and get reminders. It should start for individual students, not schools. Ask only the most important decision-blocking questions. For every choice, give options, pros, cons, and your final recommendation. For everything else, research and use best-fit defaults. Do not take shortcuts. Generate docs/app-plan, run $specforge-reviewer, and run strict validation.
```
